about: Where each agent Orchestraty connects to stands. The agents table in README.md is generated from this file by scripts/agents_table.py, and a test checks that the two agree. An agent is called supported only when its capture test with the real agent passed (result: pass); until then it is built, and not yet tested with the real agent. Agents without hooks are followed through git alone: basic support (git only).

agents.agent: Any other agent, editor or person
